content.short: Cregis provides enterprise-grade MPC Wallet as a Service and Crypto Payments Solutions for institutions.
content.description: Cregis delivers enterprise‑grade crypto asset infrastructure designed for institutions, emphasizing MPC Wallet as a Service and integrated crypto payments solutions. Since 2017, Cregis has partnered with more than 3,500 enterprises, processed assets totaling over US$10 billion, and earned a 95% customer satisfaction rate. Its portfolio includes self-hosted wallet options, WaaS interfaces, and a Crypto Payment Gateway, with wide usage across exchanges, asset management, payments, cross‑border e‑commerce, and related sectors.
